audience: payroll and operations managers who track hours in Timesheets.com

useCases.title: See who is clocked in today
useCases.text: List the clock status of several users, or of the users one supervisor manages. Then list the running project timers of one user.

useCases.title: Build the hourly report for a period
useCases.text: Get the hourly time report for a date range, grouped and summarised or detailed. Choose processed or unprocessed records.

useCases.title: Preview a payroll run before it closes
useCases.text: List the hourly payroll periods, then preview the payroll for a date range and users. The preview does not close a payroll period.

useCases.title: Assign customers or projects to a user
useCases.text: List the items, then add customers, projects or account codes to a user, and set the default. Existing assignments stay as they are.

useCases.title: Invite a new employee
useCases.text: Create a user in the company. Set send_notification_email to true to send the invitation email.
